svg.text: pressure levels: geopotential Φ, T, q, u, v
surface: Φs, ps, T2m, Td,2m, tp, SW↓, LW↓
→ points with x, y, z, S, A, Vd, H(φ)
Downscaling, by blocks of points × time steps
1 Horizontal: 3 × 3 ERA5 nodes → the column of air above each point
2 Vertical: pressure levels → elevation z of the point
3 Sun: solar geometry and terrain shading in the accumulation window
4 Physics per variable: T, q, p, wind, precipitation, SW, LW
with the options of the toposcale section of config.yml
maps: each cell takes its point's series
